poetryFrame.leftVertical: THE BEAUTY LIES NOT IN THE PERMANENT FORM,
poetryFrame.rightVertical: BUT IN THE QUIET TRUTH BEYOND ALL CHANGE.
poetryFrame.bottomLine: MY AFFECTION KNOWS NO REASON, ONLY HEART.
sonnetLines: The shifting hues of morning light,
A fragile promise, pure and bright,
In every shade of me and you.
Though seasons turn and edges blur,
And perfect lines begin to fade,
We build our shelter on the sand,
Yet hold a truth within your hand,
For love requires no visible sign,
Just knowing that forever is mine.

lyrics.text: You could have eyes that are brown or blue
You could lose all your hair, to tell you the truth
You could be rather short or unusually tall
I don't care, makes no difference at all
You could say that you hate me when you're feeling mad
You could change your style to the latest fad
You could try to act cool just to trip and fall
I don't care 'cause I love you for no reason at all
You could lie about your feelings, pretend you're alright
When you're tired of pretending, I'll hold you tight
You could find it hard to know what is right from what's wrong
I don't care, makes no difference at all
You could make a thousand mistakes and then a couple more
You could make a lot of money or be a little poor
You could move somewhere far away and then forget to call
I don't care 'cause I love you for no reason at all
I don't care 'cause I love you for no reason at all
